The '''Kettius Expedition''' was an expedition led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kettius]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in an ill-fated effort to conduct geological surveys of the ice-covered world. The expedition had perished along with the doctor.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Archaeology|A Chilling Discovery}}</ref>
